jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.content: <p>Vandelay Industries is modernizing its import/export logistics platform and needs a backend developer to build order-routing services.</p><h3>Responsibilities</h3><ul><li>Build Python microservices and REST APIs for order routing</li><li>Own PostgreSQL schemas and migrations</li><li>Improve observability with structured logging and metrics</li></ul><h3>Qualifications</h3><ul><li>1+ years of experience with Python in production</li><li>Solid SQL skills</li><li>Experience with AWS</li></ul><h3>Location</h3><ul><li>This is a fully remote position open only to candidates who reside in the United States</li><li>We are unable to hire outside the United States</li></ul><p>We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.</p>

jobs.title: Software Developer, Defence Systems
jobs.content: <p>Vandelay's defence division builds mission-planning software for government clients.</p><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Develop Java and Python components for secure planning tools</li><li>Write automated tests and documentation for accredited releases</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering</li><li>Experience with Java or Python</li><li>Must hold a valid Government of Canada Secret security clearance at the time of hire</li></ul><p>Onsite in Ottawa, five days a week. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.</p>

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Join the Vandelay data team that turns shipment events into the analytics our customers rely on.</p><h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Build the batch pipelines that feed our customer analytics</li><li>Schedule and monitor workflows, and keep data quality high</li><li>Model warehouse tables with the analytics team</li></ul><h3>What you bring</h3><ul><li>2+ years of experience building data pipelines (internships count)</li><li>Strong Python and SQL</li><li>Experience with Apache Airflow</li><li>Experience with Apache Spark</li><li>dbt experience is nice to have</li></ul><p>Hybrid: 2 days a week in our Toronto office. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.</p>
